pricing.title: Choose the right plan for your team
pricing.subtitle: Unlock the full potential of your customer journey mapping with our flexible pricing plans.

landing.heroTitle: Map, Manage, and Master Your Customer Journeys
landing.heroSubtitle: Create dynamic Journey Maps and detailed Personas that evolve with your product. Stop drawing static diagrams and start managing the real user experience
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need for journey management
landing.featuresSubtitle: From mapping touchpoints to collaborating with your team—IteroJM keeps it simple and powerful.
landing.feature1Desc: Drag-and-drop visual editor to build and edit journey maps in minutes. No design skills required—focus on the story, not the pixels.
landing.feature2Desc: Keep goals, pain points, and customer data in one place. Attach personas to journey maps so the whole team stays aligned.
landing.feature3Desc: Workspaces, roles, and shared maps. Work together in real time and keep everyone on the same page.

metricsSection.title: Track performance at every step
metricsSection.subtitle: Connect your key metrics to journey maps and make decisions based on real data.
metricsSection.description: Attach conversions, NPS, churn, and other KPIs to each stage of the customer journey. See where you create value and where you lose customers, so you can prioritize the most impactful improvements.

googleSheets.title: Google Sheets
googleSheets.text: Sync spreadsheet data with your journey maps: automatically pull in conversions, NPS, churn, and other metrics and keep them updated almost in real time.

excel.title: Microsoft Excel
excel.text: Connect familiar Excel reports and aggregated tables. Reuse your existing formulas and report structure without changing internal processes.

powerBi.title: Power BI
powerBi.text: Integrate Power BI dashboards to visualize the performance of every step of the journey and track how changes impact your business outcomes.

landing.pricingSubtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you need more maps, personas, or seats.
landing.freeDesc: Basic features, limited maps and personas to get started.
landing.enterpriseDesc: Unlimited maps & personas, custom roles, priority support.
